summary: Thursday's session was dominated by a hard rotation into duration and defense: TLT surged roughly 4.5% over two weeks as the curve steepened and real yields slipped, while equity leadership flipped to staples and equal-weight names even as the Nasdaq lagged.
tweet: Treasuries ripped, staples led, tech lagged, and crypto kept sliding Thursday as cross-asset volatility stayed elevated and money rotated defensively.
